protocol.start: client -> server {'type': 'start', 'client': 'browser', 'preset': id, 'persona': text, <any param name>: value, ...}; omitted params = defaults
protocol.set: client -> server {'type': 'set', <param name>: value, ...} at any time; live params apply from the next frame; on-Start params are rejected mid-session (echoed back unchanged). hera also accepts the legacy {'type': 'cfg', ...} until v2.
protocol.ready: server -> client {'type': 'ready', ..., 'schema': <this file's params with this demo's support>, 'in_effect': {name: value}}
protocol.settings: server -> client {'type': 'settings', 'f': frame the change took effect, 'in_effect': {name: value}, 'changed': [names], 'rejected': {name: reason}}
protocol.frame: server -> client per frame {'type': 'f', ..., 's': cfg strength in effect, 'cd': mean |cond - uncond| text logit, 'tv': TV distance} (cd / tv null when no uncond stream)
protocol.validation: servers clamp to range and snap enums; the clamped value is what 'in_effect' reports

params.name: text_temp
params.hint: Temperature of B's word-lane draw, applied after the frequency penalty and before min-p / top-k / top-p. 0.05 is effectively greedy.

params.name: text_topk
params.hint: Keep only the k most likely lane tokens (0 = off). Cap 256 (GPU mask over a fixed top-256).

params.name: text_topp
params.hint: Nucleus: keep the smallest set of tokens whose probability reaches p (1.0 = off). Applied after min-p and top-k.

params.name: minp
params.hint: Min-p on the WORD choice only (PAD / NEW_WORD keep their probability; word mass preserved). 0 = off.

params.name: minp_mode
params.hint: absolute: keep word pieces with p >= min_p (top piece always kept); relative: keep p >= min_p x the top piece's p.

params.name: freq_pen
params.hint: Word-piece logits lowered by strength x count among B's last N sampled word pieces; total word mass kept, PAD / NEW_WORD untouched. 0 = off.

params.name: freq_win
params.hint: Window N of the frequency penalty, in sampled word pieces.

params.name: text_rep
params.hint: CTRL repetition penalty on B's text (word pieces seen in the last W sampled pieces: logit / pen if > 0 else x pen). 1.0 = off.

hera2.status: live (new in the demo; hera's own sampler has none, default off)

params.name: text_rep_win
params.hint: Window W of the text repetition penalty, in sampled word pieces.

params.name: cb0_temp
params.hint: Temperature of codebook 0 (semantic) of B's audio.

params.name: cb0_topk
params.hint: Top-k of codebook 0.

params.name: light_temp
params.hint: Temperature of codebooks 1-31 (the light / depth decoder).

params.name: light_topk
params.hint: Top-k of codebooks 1-31.

params.name: audio_rep
params.hint: CTRL repetition penalty on every codebook for codes B produced in the last W frames. 1.0 = off (default, user decision 10-09; hera's offline samples used 1.05).

params.name: audio_rep_win
params.hint: Window W of the audio repetition penalty, in frames of B's own generated codes.

params.name: cfg_on
params.hint: Classifier-free guidance on what B hears: cond = your audio, uncond = training-like silence (same B tokens / codes fed to both every frame). Off = s 1 (exactly the normal model).

fixed_not_exposed.name: grammar_mask
fixed_not_exposed.value: after NEW_WORD: word pieces only; after PAD: PAD or NEW_WORD; else word pieces + PAD + NEW_WORD; control / EOB never
fixed_not_exposed.why_not_exposed: the trained lane format (= hera_gen / model-2 samples)

fixed_not_exposed.name: text_rep_pen
fixed_not_exposed.why_not_exposed: hera's sampler has no text repetition penalty (only the frequency penalty)

fixed_not_exposed.name: pad_bias
fixed_not_exposed.why_not_exposed: no PAD bias exists in either sampler

fixed_not_exposed.name: order
fixed_not_exposed.value: CFG mix -> grammar mask -> freq penalty -> temperature -> min-p -> top-k -> top-p -> draw
fixed_not_exposed.why_not_exposed: fixed pipeline; shown as a hint

fixed_not_exposed.name: voxtral_front
fixed_not_exposed.value: 3 ms lookahead, mel floor global max - 8, 15 s sliding window
fixed_not_exposed.why_not_exposed: must equal the training front end (streaming parity cos >= 0.9998)

fixed_not_exposed.name: precision
fixed_not_exposed.value: bf16 weights, fp32 logits / Mimi, TF32 off

quiet_frame_bank.method: quiet A frames (frame RMS of the A audio exactly as the model's training input saw it < 1e-3), contiguous runs >= 4 frames, from held-out (split.json eval) chunk-00 rows, both speakers, excluding the test conversation; keep the raw audio of those frames (for the ear) AND the data's own A Mimi codes of the SAME frames (codes_user), so code and audio are paired as in training; 4,200 frames. Uncond stream: system block hears digital silence (as the collator), conversation frames f hear bank frame f (audio through the same streaming ear; codes from the bank).
quiet_frame_bank.tables_code: $ALOE_ROOT/qwen-1ch/hera-ft/live/live_hooks.py _noise_tables (Voxtral over [200 silent frames + bank] in 256-frame chunks -> adapter) + install_uncond_noise
quiet_frame_bank.model2_note: model 2's A input is -23 LUFS loudness-matched and its training codes were made after -23 LUFS: build its bank from ITS stores' codes_user and apply its own A preprocessing to the bank audio before its ear; do not reuse hera's raw-level bank as is.
